description: This Dart class, ConnectivityMonitor, provides a simplified interface for monitoring connectivity status. Currently, it simulates always being online and includes placeholders for future enhancements using connectivity signals.

classes.name: ConnectivityMonitor
classes.description: A class to simulate online connectivity status, providing a stream and a boolean getter for connectivity state.

methods.name: ConnectivityMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitor, currently set to simulate always-online.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Closes the internal stream controller to free resources.
